name: Process: Run the compensation mechanics and review module for every person in onboarding and for every lead and founder before the first interview they run
text_content:
I8 as a process. Every person completes the everyone half on scheduled shift as part of the training plan's paid time, in their languages, before their first pay date; every lead and both founders complete the lead half before handing item 6 at a first interview, beside their interviewer training, because the record requires that whoever hands the mechanics can explain them, and every lead completes it again before the first review they hold; the module writes a training record state from the stack and teaches nothing about anyone's pay. Extends 86akh9tar, 86akhb2kw, and 17tn048qckj by reference. High.

Filed by Session 13 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmjey. Reasoning lives on the S13 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
